_readme: This repository's OWN allowances for kw_common.leakguard. A key prefixed with `_` is a comment and is the only spelling this scanner ignores - anything else it does not read is refused, so a typo cannot silently drop the rules below. This file must stay TRACKED: an untracked one is refused, precisely so an allowance cannot govern a scan while being invisible to review. Format: README.md.
_why_no_path_exempt: This repository OWNS the engine, so its source is a tracked file full of synthetic deny cases - and the first version of this file excused all eight patterns on that one path. That was a whole-file skip written in data: a REAL leak appended to the engine's source passed, which is the exact blind spot the hardcoded self-path used to leave, moved from code into config. The guard now recognises its own source by its BYTES, which nothing else in any repository can claim and no config can widen. No path_exempt entry is needed here, and there should be none.

allow_literals.why: functional: this repository's own clone URL. Inert against the shape denylist, live against the project-side real-literal guard that shares this engine.
functional: raw asset URLs. Same reasoning as the clone URL above.
functional: image pulls. Neutralizing it would break them; it is an account name, not infrastructure.
